verdict.rationale: Parahelp documents automatic ingestion of past resolved tickets, plus research of "everything you've connected," to generate baseline knowledge configurations without manual authoring, and it keeps a versioned live knowledge base. The docs never name help centers, product docs, or internal wikis as connectable knowledge sources. Missing for 10: explicit help-center/docs/wiki ingestion, documented supported knowledge source types, ongoing sync of sources, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, the agent ingests my help center, docs, past tickets, and internal wikis as knowledge sources without manual re-authoring

citations.quote: It connects to your ticketing system, analyzes your last 100-1,000 resolved tickets, and researches everything you've connected to set up baseline Customer Agent configurations: memory, knowledge, and base tools.
the Internal Agent analyzes your last 500-1,000 resolved tickets along with your existing context to build the first version of your Customer Agent
See your live knowledge and its version history - who published what and when, with a diff for every change
